roles.name: bookings.coach
roles.label: Coach
roles.description: Sees the day's classes and each class's list, and ticks who came (or marks who did not). Nothing else: no money, no other people, no booking or cancelling, no settings.

roles.name: ticketing.door
roles.label: Door
roles.description: Checks tickets in at the door and sees events, ticket types and tickets. Nothing else: no people, orders, leads or settings.
